title: Hill climb and push · Level 1: Up the ramp
brief: Climb the 25° ramp (600 mm, 280 mm up) and stop with the whole robot in the green zone on the platform; the run ends when your program ends (and the robot stands still), or at 60 s; the zone is judged then (a program that stops on an error gets no zone). Five starts on the floor 300 mm before the ramp (±10 mm, ±2°). 50 for ending wholly in the zone, plus 40 × min(1, par ÷ time) with it, plus 10 if the robot never rolled back more than 10 mm down the ramp. Pass: mean 60 or more and at least 4 of 5 runs in the zone.

score.run: let c = cosd(endHeading) in let s = sind(endHeading) in let hx = abs(bodyHalf * s) in let hy = abs(bodyHalf * c) in let inZone = min(endX + bodyFront * c, endX - bodyRear * c) - hx >= zoneX0 & max(endX + bodyFront * c, endX - bodyRear * c) + hx <= zoneX1 & min(endY + bodyFront * s, endY - bodyRear * s) - hy >= zoneY0 & max(endY + bodyFront * s, endY - bodyRear * s) + hy <= zoneY1 in if(inZone & (stopped | time >= limitS), 50 + 40 * min(1, par / time), 0) + if(!rolledBack, 10, 0)
